senses.en: to persuade someone by flattery or sweet talk

example.en: She wheedled an extra day off out of her boss.
example.zh: 她用甜言蜜语从老板那里多哄得了一天假。

senses.en: a device on a bicycle wheel that lets the wheel turn freely without pedaling

example.en: The bike's freewheel clicks as he coasts downhill.
example.zh: 他下坡滑行时，自行车的飞轮咔嗒作响。

senses.en: to coast on a vehicle without pedaling or using the engine

example.en: The cyclists freewheeled down the long hill.
example.zh: 骑行者们顺着长长的山坡滑行而下。

senses.en: to live in a relaxed, free, or carefree way
senses.zh: 随心所欲地生活；放任自流

example.en: He freewheeled through his twenties, avoiding any real commitments.
example.zh: 他二三十岁时随心所欲地生活，回避一切真正的责任。

senses.en: a person who plays golf
senses.zh: 打高尔夫球的人；高尔夫球手

example.en: The golfer hit the ball onto the green.
example.zh: 那位高尔夫球手把球打上了果岭。

senses.en: to put a piece of equipment or software in place and make it ready to use

example.en: We installed a new printer in the office.
example.zh: 我们在办公室安装了一台新打印机。

senses.en: to formally put someone in an important position

example.en: The new mayor was installed in office last week.
example.zh: 新市长上周正式就职。

senses.en: to create or design something new

example.en: She invented a new kind of water filter.
example.zh: 她发明了一种新型滤水器。

senses.en: to make up something false

example.en: He invented an excuse for being late.
example.zh: 他为迟到编了个借口。

senses.en: relating to or involving two or more countries
senses.zh: 国际的；涉及两个或更多国家的

example.en: The two countries signed an international agreement on trade.
example.zh: 两国签署了一项国际贸易协定。

senses.en: a sports match between national teams, or a player who represents their country
senses.zh: 国际比赛；代表国家参赛的运动员

example.en: She played her first international last year.
example.zh: 她去年参加了她的第一场国际比赛。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand; clearly

example.en: She was obviously tired after the trip.
example.zh: 旅行结束后，她显然很累。

senses.en: a tool used for cutting things

example.en: Use a wire cutter to remove the cable ties.
example.zh: 用剪线钳把扎带剪断。

senses.en: a person whose job is cutting something

example.en: The film cutter edited the scenes late into the night.
example.zh: 影片剪辑师熬夜剪辑场景。

senses.en: a small fast sailing ship or coastguard boat
senses.zh: 单桅小帆船；（缉私）巡逻艇

example.en: A coastguard cutter patrolled the harbor entrance.
example.zh: 一艘海岸警卫队巡逻艇在海港入口巡逻。

senses.en: the largest planet, fifth from the Sun

example.en: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
example.zh: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星。

senses.en: the supreme god in Roman mythology, equivalent to the Greek Zeus
senses.zh: 朱庇特（罗马神话中的主神，相当于希腊神话中的宙斯）

example.en: In Roman mythology, Jupiter was the king of the gods.
example.zh: 在罗马神话中，朱庇特是众神之王。

senses.en: pictures or visual images, especially in art, literature, or media
senses.zh: 意象；（艺术、文学中的）图像，形象

example.en: The poem is full of vivid imagery of the sea.
example.zh: 这首诗充满生动的海洋意象。

senses.en: a person who manages or supervises an organization, department or building
senses.zh: 主管人；监督人；（楼房的）管理员

example.en: The school superintendent announced a new education plan.
example.zh: 学校主管宣布了一项新的教育计划。

senses.en: a male given name

example.en: Arnold invited his classmates to the party.
example.zh: 阿诺德邀请同学参加聚会。

senses.en: Matthew Arnold, an English poet and critic (1822–1888)
senses.zh: 阿诺德（英国诗人、评论家）

example.en: We studied a poem by Arnold in class.
example.zh: 我们在课堂上学习了阿诺德的一首诗。

senses.en: Benedict Arnold, an American general who betrayed his side in the Revolution (1741–1801)
senses.zh: 阿诺德（美国独立战争中的叛将）

example.en: Benedict Arnold is often named as a famous traitor in American history.
example.zh: 本尼迪克特·阿诺德常被视为美国历史上著名的叛徒。

senses.en: to pass waste matter out of the body

example.en: The kidneys excrete waste products in the urine.
example.zh: 肾脏通过尿液排泄废物。

senses.en: a town or city with a harbor where ships load and unload cargo

example.en: Shanghai is one of the busiest seaports in the world.
example.zh: 上海是世界上最繁忙的海港之一。

senses.en: commonly called or named, but often not truly what the name suggests

example.en: The so-called expert gave advice that turned out to be wrong.
example.zh: 这位所谓的专家给出的建议结果是错的。

senses.en: not easy; needing a lot of effort or skill

example.en: Learning a new language is difficult.
example.zh: 学习一门新语言很困难。

senses.en: hard to deal with; not cooperative

example.en: Her boss can be very difficult.
example.zh: 她的老板有时很难相处。

senses.en: a person who creates plans or drawings for things such as clothes, buildings, or products

example.en: She is a talented fashion designer who works in Paris.
example.zh: 她是一位在巴黎工作的才华横溢的时装设计师。

senses.en: made by a famous designer and usually expensive and fashionable
senses.zh: 名牌的；由设计师设计的

example.en: He bought a designer handbag for his sister.
example.zh: 他给妹妹买了一个名牌手提包。

senses.en: wanting or seeking revenge

example.en: In the story, a vengeful spirit haunts the old house.
example.zh: 在故事中，一个复仇的鬼魂出没于那座老宅。

senses.en: a school for training musicians or other artists
senses.zh: （音乐、戏剧等艺术）专科学校；音乐学院

example.en: She studied violin at a famous conservatory in Vienna.
example.zh: 她在维也纳一所著名的音乐学院学习小提琴。

senses.en: a glass room or building for growing plants

example.en: They grow oranges in the conservatory all year round.
example.zh: 他们一年四季都在温室里种植橙子。

senses.en: (Mandarin) Standard Chinese, or the group of Chinese varieties on which it is based

example.en: She speaks fluent Mandarin.
example.zh: 她说一口流利的普通话。

senses.en: an official in imperial China; also a powerful senior official or influential member of an elite group
senses.zh: （旧时中国的）官员；（政府或行业中的）要员

example.en: Senior mandarins opposed the reform plan.
example.zh: 政府高层官员反对这项改革计划。

senses.en: a small sweet citrus fruit with loose, easy-to-peel skin

example.en: She peeled a mandarin and gave me half.
example.zh: 她剥开一个橘子，分了我一半。

senses.en: to make a bubbling sound, as water flowing

example.en: Water gurgled down the drain.
example.zh: 水汩汩地流进下水道。

senses.en: a bubbling sound

example.en: We heard the gurgle of the stream.
example.zh: 我们听到了小溪的汩汩声。

senses.en: the part of the body on either side of the backbone between the ribs and the hips

example.en: The patient complained of severe pain in the loins.
example.zh: 病人主诉腰部剧烈疼痛。

senses.en: a cut of meat from this part of an animal

example.en: She grilled a tender pork loin for dinner.
example.zh: 她晚餐烤了一块鲜嫩的猪腰肉。

senses.en: an informal word for grandfather

example.en: Grandpa told us stories by the fire.
example.zh: 爷爷在炉边给我们讲故事。

senses.en: a sweet sugar mixture used to cover and decorate cakes

example.en: The cake was covered with pink icing.
example.zh: 蛋糕上覆盖着粉红色的糖霜。

senses.en: the formation of ice on a surface, such as aircraft wings or roads

example.en: Icing on the wings forced the pilot to turn back.
example.zh: 机翼结冰迫使飞行员返航。

senses.en: the state of being lower in rank or importance than someone or something else
senses.zh: 从属；下级地位；次要地位

example.en: The subordination of individual interests to team goals was expected.
example.zh: 个人利益服从团队目标是被期待的。

senses.en: the grammatical linking of a dependent clause to a main clause

example.en: Subordination connects clauses of unequal importance.
example.zh: 从属关系连接重要性不等的从句。

senses.en: to make an effort to do something

example.en: I tried to call you twice this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上我试着给你打了两次电话。

senses.en: to test something to see if it works or is good

example.en: Try this soup before you add more salt.
example.zh: 加盐之前先尝一下这汤。

senses.en: an attempt to do something

example.en: It was a good try, but the ball missed the goal.
example.zh: 这是一次不错的尝试，但球没进门。

senses.en: used before a noun to point to a particular person or thing that is near or already mentioned
senses.zh: 用于名词前，指附近或已提到的人或事物

example.en: This book is mine.
example.zh: 这本书是我的。

senses.en: the person or thing that is near or has just been mentioned
senses.zh: 附近或刚提到的人或事物

example.en: This is my older sister.
example.zh: 这是我的姐姐。

senses.en: to the degree or amount shown or stated

example.en: Can you make it this small?
example.zh: 你能把它做得这么小吗？

senses.en: an emotion or emotional state

example.en: She had a strong feeling of happiness after the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息后，她有一种强烈的幸福感。

senses.en: a physical sensation in the body

example.en: I felt a burning feeling in my throat.
example.zh: 我感到喉咙里有灼烧感。

senses.en: an opinion, belief, or intuition

example.en: I have a feeling that she is right.
example.zh: 我有种预感，她是对的。

senses.en: a body temperature that is higher than normal, often caused by illness

example.en: The nurse checked whether she had a fever.
example.zh: 护士检查了她是否发烧。

senses.en: a disease or condition that causes a high body temperature

example.en: The doctor treated patients with tropical fevers.
example.zh: 医生治疗了患热带热病的病人。

senses.en: a state of strong excitement or enthusiasm

example.en: The city was caught in football fever before the final.
example.zh: 决赛前，这座城市陷入了足球狂热。

senses.en: something known to be true or to exist

example.en: It is a fact that pure water boils at about 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.
example.zh: 纯水在标准大气压下约于 100°C 沸腾，这是事实。

senses.en: information or evidence about a situation

example.en: We need all the facts before making a decision.
example.zh: 做决定前我们需要了解全部事实。

senses.en: a number of things tied, wrapped or packed together

example.en: She carried a bundle of newspapers to the recycling bin.
example.zh: 她把一捆报纸拿到回收箱。

senses.en: to tie or pack things together, or to push something hurriedly somewhere
senses.zh: 捆扎；打包；（常指匆忙地）塞进，推走

example.en: The old books were bundled together and stored in the attic.
example.zh: 旧书被捆在一起存放在阁楼里。

senses.en: lacking experience or judgment; too ready to believe things

example.en: It was naive of him to trust a stranger with his password.
example.zh: 他把密码交给陌生人真是太天真了。

senses.en: simple and natural, without sophistication or pretense

example.en: Her naive art style has become very popular.
example.zh: 她质朴纯真的艺术风格非常受欢迎。

senses.en: an action taken in advance to avoid danger or problems

example.en: Take precautions against fire before leaving the house.
example.zh: 离开房子前要采取防火措施。

senses.en: to put something into something else

example.en: Insert the key into the lock and turn it.
example.zh: 把钥匙插进锁里，然后转动。

senses.en: something placed inside another thing, such as a page or card added to a publication or package
senses.zh: 插入物；（书刊、包装内的）插页

example.en: The magazine included an advertising insert.
example.zh: 这本杂志夹带了一张广告插页。

senses.en: to win or succeed against opposition

example.en: Justice prevailed in the end.
example.zh: 正义最终获胜。

senses.en: to be common or widespread at a certain time or place

example.en: A calm atmosphere prevailed in the room.
example.zh: 房间里一片安宁的气氛。

senses.en: to continue to be valid or in effect

example.en: The old rules still prevail in that department.
example.zh: 旧规定在那个部门仍然有效。

senses.en: (prevail on/upon) to persuade someone to do something

example.en: She finally prevailed on him to stay for dinner.
example.zh: 她终于说服他留下来吃晚饭。

collocations: prevail on someone to do something

senses.en: living or growing in water, or related to water
senses.zh: 水生的；水中的；与水有关的

example.en: The lake is home to many aquatic plants.
example.zh: 湖里生长着许多水生植物。

senses.en: an aquatic plant or animal, or water sports (usually plural)
senses.zh: 水生动植物；（复数）水上运动

example.en: The center offers classes in aquatics for all ages.
example.zh: 该中心为各年龄段提供水上运动课程。

senses.en: to come or flow out from a source

example.en: A pleasant smell emanated from the kitchen.
example.zh: 一股怡人的香味从厨房里散发出来。

senses.en: behaving in a controlled way and following rules

example.en: He is a disciplined athlete who trains every morning.
example.zh: 他是一个自律的运动员，每天早晨训练。

senses.en: trained mentally or physically through instruction or practice
senses.zh: 受过训练的；训练有素的

example.en: The disciplined troops moved in perfect formation.
example.zh: 训练有素的部队以整齐的队形行进。

senses.en: the worship of idols or physical objects as gods

example.en: The old temple practices were criticized as idolatry.
example.zh: 古老的庙宇习俗被批评为偶像崇拜。

senses.en: excessive admiration for a person or thing

example.en: His idolatry of wealth shaped all his decisions.
example.zh: 他对财富的盲目崇拜影响了他所有的决定。

senses.en: impossible to defeat or subdue; showing great courage
senses.zh: 不屈不挠的；不可战胜的

example.en: She showed indomitable courage during the long struggle.
example.zh: 在长期的斗争中，她表现出不屈不挠的勇气。

senses.en: to produce or sell something illegally, especially alcohol or recordings
senses.zh: 非法制造或销售（尤指酒类、录像制品）

example.en: During Prohibition, people bootlegged whiskey across the border.
example.zh: 禁酒令时期，人们非法越境贩卖威士忌。

senses.en: made or sold illegally

example.en: He bought a bootleg copy of the movie at the market.
example.zh: 他在市场买了一张盗版电影。

senses.en: the hard outer shell covering the body of animals such as turtles and crabs

example.en: The turtle withdrew its head into its carapace.
example.zh: 乌龟把头缩进了甲壳里。

senses.en: an area of open wild land with sandy soil and low shrubs

example.en: They walked for miles across the open heath.
example.zh: 他们在开阔的荒野上走了好几英里。

senses.en: a low evergreen shrub with small pink or purple flowers

example.en: Purple heath covered the hillside in late summer.
example.zh: 夏末，紫色的石楠铺满了山坡。

senses.en: to speak or recite loudly and dramatically

example.en: He declaimed a passage from Shakespeare at the contest.
example.zh: 他在比赛中朗诵了莎士比亚的一段作品。

senses.en: a person who says that someone has done something wrong or illegal

example.en: The accuser gave evidence in court.
example.zh: 指控者在法庭上提供了证据。

senses.en: planted and grown in a pot

example.en: She keeps several potted plants on the balcony.
example.zh: 她在阳台上摆了几盆盆栽植物。

senses.en: preserved in a pot, can, or jar (chiefly British)

example.en: The shop sells potted meat and potted shrimps.
example.zh: 这家店出售罐装肉和罐装虾。

senses.en: a feeling of being very tired, from physical or mental effort

example.en: A deep weariness came over her after the long shift.
example.zh: 长时间的值班后，她感到深深的疲惫。

senses.en: to end a meeting or session, often to continue later

example.en: The judge adjourned the hearing until Monday.
example.zh: 法官宣布听证会休会至星期一。

senses.en: treating others as if they are less intelligent or important
senses.zh: 屈尊俯就的；显得高人一等的

example.en: I disliked his patronizing tone.
example.zh: 我不喜欢他那居高临下的语气。

senses.en: things that contribute to a result

example.en: Several factors influenced her decision to move.
example.zh: 几个因素影响了她搬家的决定。

senses.en: numbers that divide another number exactly

example.en: The factors of 12 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 12.

senses.en: to confuse someone, especially by making them drunk

example.en: Too much wine fuddled his mind.
example.zh: 过多的酒使他的头脑迷糊了。

senses.en: a state of confusion, especially from drinking

example.en: He spent the evening in a fuddle.
example.zh: 他整晚都醉醺醺的。

senses.en: the sport of racing horses, often with betting

example.en: Horseracing is a popular sport in Britain.
example.zh: 赛马是英国一项受欢迎的运动。

senses.en: the punctuation mark ; used to link closely related clauses

example.en: Use a semicolon to join two related sentences.
example.zh: 用分号连接两个相关的句子。

senses.en: an ancient device that measures time by the flow of water

example.en: The ancient Egyptians used a water-clock to track the hours.
example.zh: 古埃及人用水钟来计时。
